content.short: Meshpay accepts crypto payments from 300+ wallets and exchanges, settling in stablecoins or fiat.
content.description: Meshpay connects payment service providers, wallets and exchanges so a merchant can accept crypto with lower fees and fewer failed transactions, settling in stable assets. Deposits can be pulled from more than 300 platforms, with wallet ownership verified quickly before funds move. More than a hundred large companies use it, and the team runs a Mesh Alliance program aimed at reducing fragmentation between crypto payment providers.
content.meta: Take payment from a customer's existing exchange or wallet account, settling in stablecoins or fiat.
